facts.text: The README describes eeUVsim as a Fossen-physics multi-platform AUV simulator with dynamics, reinforcement-learning scripts, robot models and actuator models, trained over ROS 2 pub-sub.
The README states that Gazebo 11 Classic is only used for visualization without physics.
The UCAT quick start launches spawn_UCAT.launch.py and trains with 'ros2 run eeuv_sim RL_UCAT.py -o'.
AUVMotion imports gazebo_msgs/EntityState.
AUVMotion creates a publisher for gazebo_msgs/EntityState on the absolute /ucat/state topic with queue size 10.
AUVMotion imports std_msgs/Bool.
AUVMotion subscribes to the absolute /ucat/reset topic with std_msgs/Bool and calls reset_callback.
AUVMotion creates a SetEntityState client on the absolute /gazebo/set_entity_state service.
AUVMotion's timer integrates body velocity and position every tick (vel += acc * dt, pos += pos_dot * dt) and then publishes the state; the loop has no stop or pause flag.
reset_callback calls reset() when the current time differs from the previous reset time by more than 10000 ns; reset() zeroes pos, vel, acc and U and sets position z to 5.
reset() builds an EntityState, publishes it on /ucat/state and calls /gazebo/set_entity_state; it does not stop the moveFins timer or the fin command stream.
moveFins subscribes to the absolute /hw/flippers_cmd topic with eeuv_sim_interfaces/Flippers and publishes FlippersFeedbacks on the absolute /hw/flippers_feedback topic.
moveFins subscribes to the absolute /ucat/reset topic with std_msgs/Bool.
moveFins.reset_joints sends the four fins to their initial poses but leaves the fin timer running.
flippersCallback copies amplitude, frequency, zero_direction and phase_offset from each of the four Flipper messages without checking any bound.
The Flipper message comments motor_number as 0..3, frequency in Hz, zero_direction and amplitude in rad, and phase_offset as 0...2 Pi.
The Flippers message carries a std_msgs/Header and an array of Flipper messages.
The FlippersFeedback message carries angular_pos, angular_vel and angular_acc.
FlippersFeedbacks carries a Header and the four named feedbacks flipper_fr, flipper_br, flipper_bl and flipper_fl.

RL_UCAT's oscillation action space bounds the four amplitudes to 0..0.85 and the four zero directions to -pi..pi in the order FR, BR, BL, FL; this is the training action space, not a clamp in moveFins.
RL_UCAT uses a single frequency of 2.0 Hz and phase offsets [0.0, 3.14159, 0, 3.14159] for the four fins.
RL_UCAT's SendActionROS2 creates publishers on /ucat/reset, /hw/flippers_cmd_e2e and /hw/flippers_cmd, and subscribes /ucat/state, /hw/flippers_feedback and /ucat/depth_vel.
pub_action_oci writes each Flipper's frequency, amplitude, zero_direction and phase_offset and publishes the Flippers message; it reads no acknowledgement.
moveFins clamps its internal fin velocity to pi * 16 rad/s and its internal acceleration to 64 rad/s^2; these are simulation-loop clamps, not bounds on the Flippers command.
moveFins sends each fin pose through /gazebo/set_entity_state with reference_frame base_link.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies with no Fossen integration, fin CPG, Gazebo scene or wall-clock timer; placeholder state does not establish a trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free analytic contract stand-in, not the upstream simulator and not a recording of captured traffic: it answers the declared topics with placeholder messages and runs no Fossen dynamics, fin CPG, Gazebo scene, ROS graph or timer
the /ucat/state pose and twist and all /hw/flippers_feedback values are placeholders and do not follow a fin command; the real pose comes from AUVMotion's integration
AUVMotion's Python dynamics runs at 0.01 s divided by the configured fast_forward value (AUVMotion.py:75-76,295-311); the fake declares no timestep and no pacing
the /ucat/reset Bool publication is recorded but not executed; the fake does not zero a simulated state, publish a reset EntityState or call /gazebo/set_entity_state

the e-stop is a sensed-confirmation stop (SAFE-049, simulated only): zero-amplitude Flippers on /hw/flippers_cmd, confirmed only by three fresh /ucat/state twist samples (arrival freshness, min_interval_ms 5, publisher at AUVMotion.py:113); /ucat/reset is not a request step because reset() does not clear the fin command moveFins stored (AUVMotion.py:423-429, moveFins.py:163-169)

the shipped timer is 10 ms (dt 0.01 at AUVMotion.py:75, fast_forward 1.0 at rl_setting.yaml:2). Three counted samples span two periods. That span, compared in milliseconds, lands just under 20, so min_span_ms is 19; a bound of 20 rejects the shipped period. A fast_forward above 1 shortens the span below 19 ms and the stop fails closed unless the operator lowers min_span_ms to match. A fast_forward above 2 also publishes faster than min_interval_ms 5 and fails closed. A replay spaced at or above 5 ms is not distinguished from live samples
the RL_UCAT default end-to-end topic /hw/flippers_cmd_e2e has no subscriber at this pin (moveFins.py:139 subscribes /hw/flippers_cmd only), so it is not exposed as a control capability
the LAUV and Blue thruster/wing topics, /ucat/force_fins, /ucat/force_fins_debug, /ucat/depth_vel, /gazebo/set_entity_state, Gazebo, RViz and the RL training stack are NOT COVERED
no ROS graph, Gazebo process or hardware is contacted; a live run needs the operator's ROS 2 graph and rosbridge endpoint

thresholds.name: body_linear
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest bound for the body twist; the operator supplies the largest magnitude that counts as stopped

thresholds.name: body_angular
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest bound for the body twist; the operator supplies the largest magnitude that counts as stopped

operator_required.name: set_fin_oscillation
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone bounds Flipper.amplitude: moveFins.py copies it into the CPG without a check, and the RL 0..0.85 rad action space is a training envelope, not a runtime clamp; the site supplies its fin amplitude envelope

operator_required.name: set_fin_oscillation
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone bounds Flipper.frequency: moveFins.py uses it directly and the RL client's 2.0 Hz is a client constant, not a runtime clamp; the site supplies its frequency envelope

operator_required.name: set_fin_oscillation
operator_required.reason: Flipper.msg comments the phase offset as 0...2 Pi but moveFins.py does not enforce that range; the site supplies its phase offset envelope

operator_required.name: set_fin_oscillation
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone bounds Flipper.zero_direction: moveFins.py copies it without a check and the RL -pi..pi action space is a training envelope, not a runtime clamp; the site supplies its direction envelope

safe_state.description: Simulated only: zero-amplitude flippers are on /hw/flippers_cmd and the /ucat/state linear and angular twist are inside the operator bounds for three fresh samples.
